newsitem.title: ROMANIA: MINOR TREMOR SHAKES EASTERN ROMANIA.
newsitem.headline: MINOR TREMOR SHAKES EASTERN ROMANIA.

text.p: A minor earthquake shook eastern Romania on Monday, but no damage was reported, the state news agency Rompres said.

Rompres said the tremor, measuring 3.6 degrees on the Richter open-ended scale, occurred at 4.23 a.m. local (0223 GMT) in the mountain region of Vrancea, 300 km (190 miles) northeast of the capital. The tremor was not felt in Bucharest.
